items.definition:
the action of buying and selling goods and services
International trade is important for the economy.

the act of focusing the mind on something
Please pay attention in class.

a person in a novel, play, or movie
The main character in the story is very brave.

intense dislike
He felt a strong hate for injustice.

a thing or things belonging to someone
This house is a valuable property.

the standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind
We aim for high quality in our products.

a distinctive manner of doing something
I like her unique sense of style.

a formal indication of a choice
Every citizen has the right to vote.

the red liquid that circulates in the arteries and veins
Blood flows through our veins.

lord
The lord of the manor was a kind man.

attack
The city was under attack.

technology
Modern technology has changed our lives.

code
He wrote the code for the new software.

election
The next election is in two years.

growth, rise
There has been a significant increase in sales this quarter.

employees
The hospital staff are working hard.

profession, occupation
She has a successful career in medicine.

number, shape, person
The sales figures for this month are impressive.

act of losing, damage
The company reported a significant loss this quarter.

variant, edition
This is the latest version of the software.

military force

objective, aim
My goal is to learn a new language.

the global computer network

the accomplishment of an aim or purpose
Hard work is the key to success.

the quality or state of being true

one part in every hundred

an article or substance that is manufactured or refined for sale

We learned about Japanese culture.

a feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities, qualities, or achievements
We should show respect for elders.

a verbal or written answer
Her response was very quick.

a period of one hundred years
The 21st century began in 2001.

a price asked for goods or services; an accusation

a change which is a result or consequence of an action or other cause

freedom from disturbance; tranquility

a path or course

the number of people living in an area

the state or condition of physical touching

a connection between two things

the state of something with regard to its appearance, quality, or working order

the process of building

a single part of a series

an act of moving

the state of being safe
